IMO WEB ACCOUNTS
Top Story

IMO Secretary-General calls on States to enforce maritime rules in the Strait of Hormuz

Secretary-General urges concrete measures to ensure compliance with international maritime regulations

Find out more
Top Story

IMO Council urges stronger protection of seafarers amid threats to global shipping

Council condemns attacks on merchant shipping in the Red Sea and Black Sea, mourns loss of 25th seafarer since onset of Strait of Hormuz conflict, and renews Secretary-General’s tenure.

Find out more
Top Story

IMO Council backs second term for Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez

Decision to extend the Secretary-General’s mandate for another four years is subject to approval by the IMO Assembly in 2027.

Find out more
Top Story

Dalian Maritime University's Yu Jiajia to receive 2027 IMO Gender Equality Award

From the bridge to the classroom, Ms Yu has helped build a more inclusive maritime sector in China, serving as a role model for the global maritime community.

Find out more

IMO – the International Maritime Organization – is the United Nations specialized agency with responsibility for the safety and security of shipping and the prevention of marine and atmospheric pollution by ships. IMO's work supports the UN sustainable development goals.

What's New
View All
19 November 2026

New study explores maritime climate finance flows for SIDS and LDCs

A pilot study published by IMO maps current maritime climate finance flows and identifies opportunities to mobilize investment and improve access to finance for the maritime energy transition.

Continue Reading
19 November 2026

Western Indian Ocean and Red Sea States advance regional maritime task force, elect first woman Chair

Signatory States to the Djibouti Code of Conduct and its Jeddah Amendment (DCoC/JA) have adopted a Regional Maritime Security Strategy and agreed to advance the establishment of a Combined Maritime Task Force (CMTF), at their Ninth High-Level Meeting in Antananarivo, Madagascar (11–13 November).

Continue Reading
17 November 2026

Regional cooperation strengthened on port security in Djibouti

Maritime and law enforcement officials from Djibouti, Ethiopia, Somalia and Yemen examined ways to strengthen port security, information sharing and preparedness for maritime security incidents during a regional meeting and field exercise in Djibouti (8-12 November).
